# Problem 1

## (a)
```{r}
ggplot(data.frame(x = c(100, 900)), aes(x = x)) +
  stat_function(
    fun = dnorm,
    args = list(mean = 500, sd = 100),
    aes(color = "H0: μ = 500"),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  stat_function(
    fun = dnorm,
    args = list(mean = 530, sd = 100),
    aes(color = "μ = 530"),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Math SAT Score (M)",
    y = "Density",
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## (c)
```{r}
1 - pnorm(1.4)
```

## (d)
```{r}
qnorm(0.95)
```

## (e)
```{r}
1 - pnorm(-0.455)
```
